description: This file defines the GrainInterfaceTypeResolver class responsible for resolving GrainInterfaceType instances from Type objects, using provided interface type providers and conventions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeResolver
classes.description: Provides methods to resolve GrainInterfaceType from Type objects, using providers and conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Resolves the GrainInterfaceType for a given interface Type, prioritizing providers and falling back to conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceTypeByConvention
methods.description: Generates a GrainInterfaceType based on default conventions for a given interface Type.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Adds generic parameters to a GrainInterfaceType if the Type is a constructed generic.
